item.text: {"explanation":"Maintain active and selected IDs by identity, filtering every transition through the current enabled option list. Keyboard navigation operates only on enabled IDs and wraps for arrows.","mapping":"The optional rule corresponds to stable identity preservation: changing option order does not change the meaning of active or selected IDs when those IDs remain enabled and present.","assumptions":"State stores the current option view plus active and selected IDs. Invalid or disabled identities are never retained or introduced.","applies":"function applies(input){return true}","holds":"function holds(input,output){const opts=(input.config.options||[]).slice(), ev=input.events||[];let o=opts,a=null,s=null;const ids=x=>o.filter(q=>!q.disabled).map(q=>q.id), ok=x=>ids(o).includes(x);a=ids().length?ids()[0]:null;const ans=[];for(const e of ev){if(e.type==='options'){o=e.options||[];const z=ids();a=z.includes(a)?a:(z[0]??null);s=z.includes(s)?s:null}else if(e.type==='click'){if(ok(e.id)){a=e.id;s=e.id}}else if(e.type==='key'){const z=ids();if(z.length){if(e.key==='Home')a=z[0];else if(e.key==='End')a=z[z.length-1];else if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'){let i=z.indexOf(a);if(i<0)i=0;else i=(i+(e.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)+z.length)%z.length;a=z[i]}else if(e.key==='Enter')s=a}}ans.push({active:a,selected:s})}return JSON.stringify(ans)===JSON.stringify(output)}","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){let st=state;if(st===null){st={o:(config.options||[]).slice(),a:null,s:null};let z=st.o.filter(x=>!x.disabled).map(x=>x.id);st.a=z.length?z[0]:null}let o=st.o,a=st.a,s=st.s;const ids=()=>o.filter(x=>!x.disabled).map(x=>x.id),has=x=>ids().indexOf(x)>=0;if(event.type==='options'){o=(event.options||[]).slice();let z=ids();a=z.indexOf(a)>=0?a:(z.length?z[0]:null);s=z.indexOf(s)>=0?s:null}else if(event.type==='click'){if(has(event.id)){a=event.id;s=event.id}}else if(event.type==='key'){let z=ids();if(z.length){if(event.key==='Home')a=z[0];else if(event.key==='End')a=z[z.length-1];else if(event.key==='ArrowDown'||event.key==='ArrowUp'){let i=z.indexOf(a);if(i<0)i=0;else i=(i+(event.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)+z.length)%z.length;a=z[i]}else if(event.key==='Enter')s=a}}st={o,a,s};return {state:st,output:{active:a,selected:s}}}"}
